second_source.name: Building footprints 2015 (view-cone ring outlines)

layers.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Vancouver (Building footprints 2009).

unverified: The 2009 metadata says "geodetic" without naming the datum; the comparison with 2022 LiDAR in the core shows no datum-sized offset (median -0.56 m at the base).

core_check.note: In the 2022 core (scratchpad check, 27 Oct): 2009 base elevation minus 2022 ground 3 m outside, median -0.56 m (n 3,189); 2009 top minus 2022 roof max for elements over 40 m, median -2.57 m (n 732). No datum-sized offset; not an accuracy statement.

layers.format: JSON, local metres east/north from CITY_ORIGIN

source.name: City engineering StreetCentreline (SURFACE_WIDTH)
source.note: In-service streets and lanes, native geometry and recorded surface widths; centred surface corridors are derived approximations, not surveyed curbs.

layers.attribution: City of Vancouver, derived geometry; Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY).

crs.note: Native City UTM coordinates retained; no WGS84 round trip.

processing.method: Native EPSG:26910 centrelines buffered by recorded SURFACE_WIDTH/2, dissolved at intersections, draped on available terrain. Ground surfaces exclude bridge-labelled records.
processing.limits: City centre lines approximate the dedicated right-of-way centre, not necessarily the physical road centre. Segment widths do not locate individual curbs, parking bays, medians or sidewalk edges. Missing widths remain centre lines. This is an approximate surface model.

datum.note: As delivered; no conversion. Terrain layers use CGVD28 via HT2_2010v70 instead.

layers.format: uint16 little endian, rows south -> north, columns west -> east; height = offset + q * scale; 65535 = no data

grid.note: x0/y0: south-west node, metres from the local origin (EPSG:26910 minus origin).

source.name: MRDEM-30 DTM (CanElevation Medium Resolution Digital Elevation Model)
source.note: Bare-earth DTM at 30 m blended from the lidar HRDEM mosaic and Copernicus GLO-30 (spec ed. 1.2). Window read by range requests (tools/fetch_mrdem_window.py).

layers.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada (Natural Resources Canada, MRDEM-30). Includes Copernicus DEM GLO-30 material, (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA.

crs.note: Resampled bilinearly from EPSG:3979 (both NAD83(CSRS)); node positions use the City's EPSG:26910 numbers (pure GRS80 UTM 10N).

datum.from: CGVD2013(CGG2013) (EPSG:6647), as declared in the MRDEM spec ed. 1.2 s6.2
datum.conversion: PROJ: Inverse of NAD83(CSRS)v6 to CGVD2013(CGG2013) height (1) + NAD83(CSRS)v6 to CGVD28 height (1) using Ballpark geographic offset from NAD83(CSRS) to NAD83(CSRS)v6 (with axis order normalized for visualization)
datum.grid_licence: Open Government Licence - Canada (Natural Resources Canada), via cdn.proj.org
datum.epoch: Both geoid models at NAD83(CSRS) epoch 2010, so the chain needs no epoch step. MRDEM's own epoch is not stated.
datum.checks: PROJ result equals N(CGG2013) - N(HT2_2010v70) from the raw grids within 2 mm at two grid nodes (-0.116, -0.183 m).
unverified: City LiDAR 2022 heights are CGVD28 through the Metro Vancouver hybrid geoid HTMVBC00, not HT2_2010v70. The difference between the two CGVD28 realisations is not measured here (expected centimetres).
MRDEM declares CGVD2013 (EPSG:6647, CGG2013); if a source tile was really on CGG2013a, the difference is millimetres to centimetres here.

processing.water: Water surfaces read about -2 m CGVD28 (a lidar-time water level, not mean sea level); the app draws the sea as its 0 m ground plane.

checks.note: City VIEWPOINT_ELEVATION_M is eye level; a median of 1-3 m at ground-level origins supports the datum chain (a sign or offset error of metres would show). Excludes E (Cambie Bridge deck) and G2 (pier).
